description: This source file defines the RedisLock class, which implements distributed locking using Redis for the OrchardCore CMS platform. It provides methods to acquire, check, and release locks asynchronously, with retry and delay logic.

classes.name: RedisLock
classes.description: Implements distributed locking using Redis, allowing tenants to acquire, check, and release named locks asynchronously.

classes.name: Locker
classes.description: Nested class implementing ILocker for managing lock disposal asynchronously and synchronously.

methods.name: AcquireLockAsync
methods.description: Waits indefinitely until acquiring a named lock with a specified expiration.

methods.name: TryAcquireLockAsync
methods.description: Attempts to acquire a named lock within a timeout, with retries and delay logic.

methods.name: IsLockAcquiredAsync
methods.description: Checks if a specific lock is currently held.

methods.name: LockAsync
methods.description: Attempts to acquire a lock asynchronously with a given expiry.

methods.name: GetDelay
methods.description: Calculates delay duration between retries with exponential backoff and jitter.
